June 29, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Zurcher Kantonalbank Zurich Cantonalbank increased its stake in Bristol Myers Squibb Co (BMY) by 6.46% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Zurcher Kantonalbank Zurich Cantonalbank bought 23,470 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.11% with the market. The institutional investor held 387,034 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $24.48 million, up from 363,564 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Zurcher Kantonalbank Zurich Cantonalbank who had been investing in Bristol Myers Squibb Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $90.39B market cap company. The stock increased 1.52% or $0.83 during the last trading session, reaching $55.3. About 10.41M shares traded or 14.19% up from the average.
